title_as_printed: Solubility of carbon dioxide in water, cc. gas S. T. P. per g. of water (columns 50, 75, 100 deg)
pressure_note: 'Total pressure, atm.' (column header); the authors state in the text that partial pressures of CO2 differ slightly (Table III) because of water vapour

value.col: Solubility of carbon dioxide in water, cc. gas S. T. P. per g. of water
value.what: cc of CO2 (S.T.P.) per 1 g of liquid water; reference state: liquid water in the saturated sample; correction of 0.734 cc/g (Bunsen 0.758 x (760-pH2O)/(760 d)) added for gas left in the sample after expansion

composition.other_species: pure water; trace dissolved iron (Table I, 7e-6 to 3.5e-5 g Fe per cc), assumed not to matter

conversion_needs: cc STP per g water to mole fraction / molality: STP definition not stated (0 C, 1 atm assumed by convention, not by the paper)
notes: Three side-by-side temperature columns (50, 75, 100 C) stacked, one label row each. Printed blanks (75 and 100 C at 125 and 600 atm) are written as empty cells; rows kept with empty value.
